This individual served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], this individual received [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at a [[Jedi academy|academy]] and eventually attained the rank of Knight. Accepting the role of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this individual was stationed on [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]] during the last part of the war. Participating in the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|battle]] there under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saras Loorne]], this Jedi was aboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunship]] with Loorne and [[Unidentified Jedi Knight 1 (Murkhana)|another Knight]] when the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] betrayed the Order with the issuance of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under this Jedi's command obeyed the executive order and shot down the Jedi's gunship, killing all three.<ref name="DL" />
